sets.dev: 12 deals used to build and tune the pipeline
sets.heldout: 8 deals with unseen brokers, layouts and phrasings; for measuring generalisation only

note: Synthetic documents for demonstration. All properties, brokers, people and companies are fictional.

deals.sub_community: Dubai Silicon Oasis (Cedre side, near Silicon Central)
deals.tests: Clean DSO mid-rise from an institutional broker, honestly documented (NIY after purchaser's costs, RERA-compliant reversion note) but priced above what the house view supports. Expected Needs work; false-flag control.
Clean International City Phase 2 building offered by a motivated seller (~11% gross on in-place, lean opex); honestly documented and priced to clear the mandate. Expected Pursue; false-flag control.
2024 JVC tower leased at 2025 peak rents: OM quotes potential rent and 97% occupancy against a 90% roll, gross ROI on asking. Over-rent risk after the 2026 fall.
documents: Sorrel Heights - Income & Expense Summary 12M Sep 2026.pdf

deals.tests: Chiller-free Business Bay tower: OM 'net yield' deducts only a service figure, Empower cooling missing from the P&L, and over 20% of rent sits above the 2026 market.

Arjan (Al Barsha South) tower, institutional OM: claims ~17% income uplift within 12 months although passing rents already sit at the screen reference (renewals 0%, re-lets add ~1%); 'FY2026' opex is Jan-Sep annualised. Near miss.
Older self-run JVC G+4: rent-roll summary row is stale and does not foot, holding-over tenants and missing Ejari shown as occupied, T-12 collections ~15% below roll. Near miss.

deals.sub_community: Dubai Silicon Oasis, near Dubai-Al Ain Road
deals.tests: 2024 DSO block leased up in one wave: ~80% of rent expires Jan-Mar 2027, OM mix is the developer brochure (120 units vs 118 let), price psf quoted on BUA, roll in sq m. Near miss.

Owner-run International City Phase 1 building sold urgently (~11% gross), OM received as a scan: income includes vacant units at asking rent and the statement has no management fee, insurance or reserve. Corrected, it is a near miss on unlevered IRR. Expected Needs work.
Business Bay tower sold as 'single ownership' but held as 96 strata title deeds with an owners association and Mollak service charges. Hard fail on title.
documents: Aurelia Bay Tower - Rent Roll Oct 2026.xlsx
Aurelia Bay Tower Owner Statement 12M Sep 2026.pdf

deals.sub_community: Al Barsha 1, behind Mall of the Emirates
deals.tests: Older Al Barsha 1 building whose OM never says freehold; the plot is nationality-restricted and the area is outside the mandate. Occupancy quoted from June. Declines on area and title (title for legal confirmation).
documents: Al Mehrab Bldg - Tenancy List Sep 2026.pdf
Al Mehrab Building - Income Statement 12M Aug 2026.pdf

deals.sub_community: Dubai Silicon Oasis, near RIT Dubai campus
deals.tests: DSO building 'guaranteed' by a 5-year master lease to the seller's own operator, at ~17% over what the operator collects; OM shows 100% occupancy vs 86% sub-let. Hard fail.
Small International City Phase 1 G+3 with two shops; income stated incl. vacant units at asking. Hard fail on size and price.

deals.sub_community: International City Phase 2 (Warsan First), Block C
deals.broker: Qamar & Partners Real Estate Brokerage L.L.C
deals.tests: International City Phase 2 building in a dense, text-heavy OM quoting several yields: 'net yield' deducts only community charges, occupancy '99% let' vs 94.5% on the roll, yields on asking. Once corrected it still clears the mandate.
documents: Almond Court - Statement of Income and Expenditure Nov25-Oct26.xlsx

deals.sub_community: Dubai Silicon Oasis, Axis Residence quarter
deals.tests: Clean DSO building from a minimalist broker whose key tables are images (no text layer); statement is a two-year comparative with a budget column. False-flag control on unseen formats.

2023 JVC block: OM headline is 'gross rental income (100% occupancy)', claims ~12% uplift from re-basing rents although most income is already above the screen reference; rent roll split across two sheets.

New Business Bay tower leased up in one wave (most rent expires Feb-Apr 2027); PDF rent roll flows across pages with an area column headed 'sq ft' that holds square metres, a total that does not foot and units without Ejari.
documents: Corvina Tower - Income Statement 12m Sep 2026 vs Sep 2025.pdf

deals.tests: Arjan building: 'FY2026F' is 8 months actual plus 4 months budget at full collection; actual collections run ~20% below the roll; OM unit mix is the developer's (117 vs 116 let). OM tables are images.
documents: Tamarind Residence - FY2025 vs FY2026F vs Budget 2027.xlsx

deals.broker: Qamar & Partners Real Estate Brokerage L.L.C
deals.tests: DSO building whose income is an 'income assurance agreement': a 3-year whole-building lease to the seller's own management company at ~15% over what it collects. Declines on the related-party test.
documents: Oryx Lane - tenancy and income assurance schedule.xlsx
Oryx Lane Residences - Landlord Statement 12m Sep 2026.pdf

deals.tests: 2006 International City Phase 1 building; OM arrives as a skewed, low-contrast photocopy. Income includes vacant units at asking, owner's costs omit management/insurance/reserve, expired and unregistered leases shown as occupied. Declines on completion year.

deals.sub_community: Dubai Sports City, Canal Residence side
deals.tests: Dubai Sports City building (outside the mandate areas, so there is no screen reference): OM shows 98% occupancy against 91.7% on the roll and ROI on asking. Declines on area.
